_about: Rating bands for Cypriot football, calibrated to EA's own FC 27 ratings for APOEL and Omonia (the only Cypriot clubs EA ships). Every number a modder enters is checked against these bands by tools/validate_ratings.py.

anchors._source: EA SPORTS FC 27 official ratings pages + FUT.GG/SoFIFA, checked 2026-11-26 (launch-item ratings).

_league_hard_cap_note: No player in any Cypriot league may exceed this, even with an override. EA's best Cyprus-based player is 75.
_override_allowance_note: A player can go up to (tier max + this), never above league_hard_cap, and only with a written override_reason (e.g. ex-big-league veteran with a known EA rating).

ea_native.description: Clubs EA already rates in FC 27. Keep EA's numbers, only fix squad changes.

title_contender.description: Clubs at APOEL/Omonia level (e.g. recent champions / European group-stage sides).

promoted_small.description: Newly promoted / smallest-budget First Division clubs (e.g. Krasava ENY Ypsonas).
